content.text: {"id": "mm7038e1", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "VE against COVID-19 hospitalizations was higher for the Moderna vaccine (93%; 95% confidence interval [CI] = 91%–95%)"}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Overall, 2,362 (64.0%) patients were unvaccinated"}]}, {"v": "continuous", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Anti-RBD levels were higher in participants vaccinated with the Moderna vaccine"}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Overall, 2,362 (64.0%) patients were unvaccinated; 476 (12.9%) were fully vaccinated with the Moderna vaccine"}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "VE for both mRNA vaccines was higher than that for the Janssen vaccine"}]}, {"v": "stratified/adjusted", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "was adjusted for admission date, geographic region, age, sex, and race and Hispanic ethnicity"}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "case-control", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "conducted a case-control analysis among 3,689 adults aged ≥18 years"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "VE against COVID-19 hospitalization was estimated using logistic regression, comparing the odds of being fully vaccinated versus unvaccinated"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "A separate model added an interaction term between product type and time since vaccination."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Statistical differences by vaccine product and time were assessed based on p-values generated using the Tukey method for pair-wise multiple comparisons."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "by vaccine product received, using the Wilcoxon rank-sum test"}, {"loc": "table 2", "q": "Models were adjusted for date of hospital admission (biweekly intervals)"}], "confidence": "high", "uncertain_fields": []}
